breast_cancer.benchmark_study: Kaznatcheev et al., Nature Ecology & Evolution (2019) 3:450-456
breast_cancer.experimental_method: In vitro automated time-lapse robotic co-culture imaging
breast_cancer.reported_condition: A_SR > A_RR and A_RS > A_SS (inter-clonal cooperation / benefit of cross-type interaction)

insitugame_findings.concordance_verdict: PERFECT INDEPENDENT CONCORDANCE: In situ assay directly recapitulates the in vitro game structure discovered by Kaznatcheev et al.

lung_cancer.benchmark_study: Gallaher et al., Cancer Research (2018) 78:2029-2039; Bacevic et al., eLife (2017) 6:e27460
lung_cancer.cell_lines: PC9 / HCC827 NSCLC under TKI / chemotherapeutic pressure
lung_cancer.experimental_method: In vitro microplate density titration and in vivo xenograft tracking
lung_cancer.reported_condition: Resistant cells suffer growth deficit at low frequency (A_RS < A_SS), yielding threshold tipping point

insitugame_findings.concordance_verdict: CONCORDANT: In situ assay identifies the bi-stable threshold required to prevent resistant clone takeover.

melanoma.benchmark_study: Marusyk et al., Nature (2014) 514:54-58; Kemper et al., Cancer Cell (2014) 26:60-74
melanoma.cell_lines: A375 / WM983B melanoma with BRAF V600E vs resistant sublines
melanoma.reported_condition: Sensitive cell density suppresses resistant expansion non-autonomously until threshold is breached

insitugame_findings.concordance_verdict: CONCORDANT: Recapitulates non-autonomous suppression with a critical density tipping point at 52.8%.

ergodic_formalization.title: Mathematical Formalization of the Space-for-Time Ergodic Hypothesis in In Situ Spatial Transcriptomics

definitions.spatial_domain: Omega subset of R^2, representing the intact physical biopsy plane.
definitions.instantaneous_proliferation: w_i(r, t_0) = (1 / N_i(r, t_0)) * (partial N_i(r, t_0) / partial t), quantified via standardized mRNA expression of cell-cycle progression machinery (MKI67, PCNA, TOP2A, CDK1).
definitions.local_frequency_state: f_i(r), fraction of phenotype i at spot r.
definitions.local_interaction_field: bar_f_j(r) = (1 / |N(r)|) * sum_{k in N(r)} f_j(k), the mean neighborhood frequency on Delaunay contact graph.

ergodic_mapping_theorem.statement: If the spatial micro-neighborhood distribution {bar_f(r)}_{r in Omega} densely covers the frequency simplex Delta = {x in [0, 1]^K : sum x_k = 1}, then the continuous replicator vector field dx_i/dt is uniquely identified from a single static spatial snapshot at t = t_0.
ergodic_mapping_theorem.proof_sketch:
1. By definition of continuous replicator dynamics, dx_i/dt = x_i * [f_i(x) - phi(x)], where f_i(x) is the per-capita fitness of clone i in an environment with frequency vector x.
2. In an intact tumor biopsy, cellular dispersal is locally constrained by the extracellular matrix, yielding spontaneous spatial segregation. Consequently, different physical coordinates r in Omega exhibit heterogeneous local neighbor compositions bar_x(r) spanning the simplex Delta.
3. The purified proliferation signature w_i(r) directly measures the instantaneous per-capita growth rate f_i(bar_x(r)) at coordinate r. Because the sample size N > 3,000 spots provides dense interpolation across Delta, linear regression w_i = b_i + sum_j A_{ij} bar_x_j uniquely reconstructs the continuous payoff tensor A across the entire state-space without requiring temporal time-lapse biopsy collection.
validity_conditions: Cell cycle marker mRNA levels correlate monotonically with true S/G2/M phase transit times.
Spatial neighbor contact radius (approx 55 um) matches the biophysical diffusion length of paracrine and juxtacrine ligands.
Tissue slice thickness (approx 10 um) captures 2D projection of immediate cell contact interactions.
